item.title: Transport company owner fined RM150,000 for owning diesel without a license
item.description: KUALA TERENGGANU: A transport company owner was fined RM150,000 by the Sessions Court here today after pleading guilty to storing diesel fuel without a licence three years ago. Judge Mohd Zul Zakiqudin Zulkifli sentenced Hasdi Mustapa, 45, to six months in prison if he failed to pay the fine. He paid the fine. item.title: 55 Malaysian Umrah pilgrims stranded in Jeddah
